name: Screenshot Capture
description: Capture screenshots from paired nodes. Decodes the base64 response and writes to disk, returning a file path the gateway converts to a mediaId.

openclawBin.description: Path to the openclaw binary (default: openclaw)

gatewayUrl.description: Gateway WebSocket URL (optional, uses default gateway config if omitted)

gatewayToken.description: Gateway auth token (optional, uses default gateway config if omitted)

invokeTimeout.description: Timeout in ms for the node invoke call (default: 30000)
